offers.offer:
Curated Multilingual NLP Dataset – 40M Tokens, Immediate Download
We are offering a professionally curated multilingual text corpus covering 12 languages, totaling approximately 40 million tokens. The dataset has been deduplicated, normalized, and filtered for toxic content using a combination of automated classifiers and human spot-checks. Provenance documentation and a datasheet following the Gebru et al. format are included. Licensing is CC BY 4.0 for research use, with a commercial addendum available separately. Delivery is via a private S3 bucket link issued within 2 hours of confirmed payment. A sample of 500,000 tokens per language is available for inspection before purchase. Full refund available within 7 days if the delivered dataset does not match the stated specifications. Price: 2.8 GEN. Payment to 0x7C4d8BBA6081063F7ebe866FD96954bB1E324B90.
